messages.subject: Using paste to concatenate html text in shiny?
parts:
I am trying to use paste to combine 2 div's but the angle brackets (< and >) get replaced by "<" and ">" as in the code below. There appear to be no verbatim option in paste function.
Any ideas? 
Many thanks

```html
accordion_head  <-  "Accordion Group Item #1 title"  %>>% 
            {shiny::a("data-toggle"="collapse","data-parent"="#accordion", href="#collapseOne","aria-expanded"="true" ,"aria-controls"="collapseOne",.)}  %>>%
            {shiny::h4(class="panel-title",.)}  %>>%
            {shiny::div(class="panel-heading",role="tab",id="headingOne",.)}


accordion_body <-  "Accordion Group Item #1 body"  %>>%
            {shiny::div(class="panel-body",.)}  %>>%
            {shiny::div(id="collapseOne", class="panel-collapse collapse in", role="tabpanel", "aria-labelledby"="headingOne",.)} 


accordion <- panel_head %>>% paste(panel_body)  %>>%  
            {shiny::div(class="panel panel-default",.)}  %>>%
            {shiny::div(class="panel-group",id="accordion",role="tablist","area-multiselectable"="true",.)}

```
